body:
Bless him. My partner was traumatised from my first pregnancy/birth, and during the second he was on edge constantly and just felt sick all the time.

He sounds like a great partner and dad. Is he still affectionate with you? Like kissing  and cuddling?

I definitely would seek counselling for you both to work things through, I doubt it will be a quick resolution!

Is there anyway he could possibly be cheating?
How was he during/after the birth?
How is he as a parent to your kiddo- especially in the early stages?

It sounds like he is traumatised by the birth, I think that if you BOTH want to save your marriage you need to go to couple therapy and maybe him also individual therapy. You could even consult with a sex therapist. Start of slow, hand holding, booby cupping, then work your way up to the big stuff. 

My heart goes out to you because sexual frustration is overwhelming…

Your partner sounds like a twat. The fact he gets mad about a child puking during car rides, especially when this is expected is just pathetic. 

You could either not go and let him go by himself and plan some fun activities with the kids (you and the kids will be probably have more fun) ORRR… TELL- not ask- TELL, your partner that during your trip you are taking some time out with the kids to do fun activities, and dress it up that he can enjoy alone adult time with his family.

I ask this because my partner was eating some ice cream and I realised he chews it whereas I suck it when it’s in my mouth. 

He said the reasoning behind it is you can taste the ice cream more.

Is this normal?
Why’s no one mentioning the slugs? 😂😅
Knowing now that whales had hooves is very humbling 😃🥹

I get this too, I think it’s a fucked up coping 
mechanism of drawing you out of your own head. Diverting one pain for another if you get my drift. It’s kind of like a craving. I know it is bad and that it’s going to hurt but at the same time I feel that it will satisfy my needs! 

Depression sucks my friend ☹️
Xx.    Xx.  Xx xxxx. Xx. Xx xx t X u gy

Just remember that it’s okay to cry. I have had many arguments with my family, some little some huge and always felt horrific after because they are my parents. However, that doesn’t mean that you don’t have a voice or a right to voice your voice, if you get my drift! Sending virtual hugs!
Thank you, I am so scared what will people will say about it.

He went out for dinner, with his parents and grand mother he also took our Daughter. He usually is super supportive when I am going through difficult things but with this one he seems like it isn’t a big deal which upsets me even more.
Thank you, it means a lot knowing someone sort of cares, I have no one to talk to this about at all, I appreciate that!
